body:
Self-contained specification for headless agy print-mode hardening, RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION 1.5.9, and the 14-row / 1,440-state classifyAgyOutcome() classifier:

1. `lib/doctor.mjs` & `test/doctor.test.mjs`:
   - Keep `export const MIN_AGY_VERSION = '1.2.6';` and add `export const RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION = '1.5.9';`.
   - In `checkAgyBinary`: attach `version: versionStr` on returned objects once `versionStr` is parsed. When `semverGte(versionStr, MIN_AGY_VERSION)` and `semverLt(versionStr, RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION)`, return `{ name: 'agy CLI', level: 'warn', version: versionStr, detail: `${v} (recommended >= v${RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION}; Orchestrator slugs auto-disabled)`, fix: `Upgrade agy to >= ${RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION} for Orchestrator (Carbon/Argon) support.` }`; when `>= RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION`, return `{ name: 'agy CLI', level: 'pass', version: versionStr, detail: v, fix: null }`. Update `test/doctor.test.mjs` for `1.2.6 <= v < 1.5.9` (`warn`) vs `>= 1.5.9` (`pass`) and `< 1.2.6` (`fail`).
   - Export `checkHookLogDir({ env = process.env, home = env.HOME || homedir() } = {})` checking `${home}/.gemini/antigravity-cli/.agb-hook-log-degraded` (returning `{ name: 'Hook audit log', level: 'warn', ... }` if the marker exists or log dir/file is a symlink, else `{ name: 'Hook audit log', level: 'pass', detail: 'healthy', fix: null }`) and wire into `runDoctor`.

2. `lib/brain.mjs`, `lib/plan.mjs`, `lib/preflight.mjs`, `lib/prosecute.mjs`, `lib/review.mjs`, `bin/agb.mjs`:
   - Add optional `disableOrchestrator: { type: 'boolean' }` to `BRAIN_PLAN_SCHEMA.properties` in `lib/brain.mjs`, and validate in `validatePlan()` (`lib/plan.mjs`) that if `plan.disableOrchestrator !== undefined`, `typeof plan.disableOrchestrator === 'boolean'`.
   - Ensure all `9/9` `runAgy()` callsites set worker env: `lib/scheduler.mjs` (`worker: { ticket }`), and `worker: { mode: 'readonly' }` on every `runAgy()` call in `lib/plan.mjs`, `lib/preflight.mjs`, `lib/brain.mjs`, `lib/prosecute.mjs`, `lib/review.mjs`, and `bin/agb.mjs` (`probe` subcommand).

3. `lib/agy.mjs` & `test/fixtures/fake-agy`:
   - In `runAgy()`, append `'--disable-slash-commands'` after `--model <slug>` whenever `options.disableSlashCommands !== false`.
   - Update `test/fixtures/fake-agy` to accept `--disable-slash-commands` and exit `2` on unknown `--*` flags during print/input-format invocations. Keep `test/agy.test.mjs` green.
   - Export `FAILURE_FINISHED_REASONS = new Set(['error', 'failed', 'aborted', 'cancelled', 'canceled', 'max_tokens', 'length', 'safety', 'recitation'])` and frozen `ALL_AGY_ERROR_KINDS` containing every non-null error `kind` `classifyAgyOutcome` / `runAgy` can return.
   - Implement and export pure helper `classifyAgyOutcome({ outputFormat, killReason = null, spawnError = null, code, signal = null, terminalResult = null, envelope = null, jsonValid = true, schemaErrorKind = null, finishedReason, out = '', err = '', lastErrLine, legacyPre150 = false, requestedModel = null })` using this exact 14-row sequential `if / else if` precedence chain:
     - Helpers:
       - Reverse-tail stderr lines (`errLines`): when `typeof code === 'number' && code !== 0`, if `lastErrLine !== undefined` use `[String(lastErrLine).trim()].filter(Boolean)`, else take up to the last `16` non-empty `\r?\n`-trimmed lines of `err` in reverse order (`newest -> oldest`); else `[]`.
       - `lastAgyErr`: first line in `errLines` matching `/^AGY_ERROR:\s*(\{[^\r\n]{1,4096}\})$/` that parses via `JSON.parse` to a plain object, else `null`.
       - `effFinishedReason = finishedReason ?? terminalResult?.finished_reason ?? envelope?.finished_reason`.
       - `isPrintTimeout`: `effFinishedReason === 'print_timeout'` OR (`!terminalResult && !envelope && code === 3 && errLines.some((l) => /^\[agy\] print timeout after \d+/.test(l))`) OR (`outputFormat === 'text' && legacyPre150 && isAgyTimeout(out)`).
       - `isModelUnavailable`: `lastAgyErr?.code === 404 || lastAgyErr?.httpStatus === 404 || lastAgyErr?.status === 'NOT_FOUND'` OR (message `m = lastAgyErr?.message ?? terminalResult?.error ?? envelope?.error` is a string matching `/^unknown model\b|model\s+['"]?[a-z0-9._-]+['"]?\s+not (?:found|available)/i` without matching `.json` file paths, and if `requestedModel` is set, `m.toLowerCase().includes(requestedModel.toLowerCase()) || /^unknown model\b/i.test(m)`).
       - `detectRateLimit`: if `lastAgyErr` has structured status/code, `true` iff `lastAgyErr.code === 429 || lastAgyErr.httpStatus === 429 || lastAgyErr.status === 'RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED'`, else regex `/\b429\b|RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED|rate[ _-]?limit(?:ed)?|quota exceeded/i` against `terminalResult?.error ?? envelope?.error ?? (code !== 0 ? errLines.join('\n') : '')`.
     - Exact 14-Row Sequential `if / else if` Branches:
       1. `killReason != null` -> `{ ok: false, kind: killReason.kind, rateLimited: false, error: killReason.error }`
       2. `spawnError != null || (code === null && signal === null)` -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'spawn', rateLimited: false, error: ... }`
       3. `code === null` (`signal !== null`) -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'signal', rateLimited: false, error: `killed by signal ${signal}` }`
       4. `isPrintTimeout` -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'timeout', rateLimited: false, error: 'print-timeout' }`
       5. `effFinishedReason === 'interrupted'` -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'interrupted', rateLimited: false, error: 'interrupted' }`
       6. `FAILURE_FINISHED_REASONS.has(String(effFinishedReason ?? '').toLowerCase()) || (outputFormat === 'stream-json' && terminalResult != null && (terminalResult.status !== 'SUCCESS' || (terminalResult.exit_code !== 0 && terminalResult.exit_code !== undefined && terminalResult.exit_code !== null))) || (outputFormat === 'json' && envelope != null && ['error', 'failed'].includes(String(envelope.status ?? '').toLowerCase()))` -> `{ ok: false, kind: isModelUnavailable ? 'model_unavailable' : (outputFormat === 'json' ? 'envelope_error' : 'server'), rateLimited: detectRateLimit(), error: ... }`
       7. `outputFormat === 'stream-json' && terminalResult != null && code !== 0` -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'server_shutdown_error', rateLimited: false, error: ... }`
       8. `outputFormat === 'stream-json' && terminalResult == null && code !== 0` -> `{ ok: false, kind: lastAgyErr ? (isModelUnavailable ? 'model_unavailable' : 'server') : 'cli', rateLimited: detectRateLimit(), error: ... }`
       9. `outputFormat === 'stream-json' && terminalResult == null` (`code === 0`) -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'missing_terminal_result', rateLimited: false, error: ... }`
       10. `outputFormat !== 'stream-json' && code !== 0` -> `{ ok: false, kind: isModelUnavailable ? 'model_unavailable' : 'server', rateLimited: detectRateLimit(), error: ... }`
       11. `outputFormat === 'json' && (!jsonValid || schemaErrorKind != null)` -> `{ ok: false, kind: schemaErrorKind ?? 'schema_violation', rateLimited: false, error: ... }`
       12. `outputFormat === 'text' && out.trim().length === 0` -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'empty', rateLimited: false, error: 'exit 0: empty output' }`
       13. `outputFormat === 'stream-json' || outputFormat === 'json' || outputFormat === 'text'` -> `{ ok: true, kind: null, rateLimited: false, error: null }`
       14. `else` -> `{ ok: false, kind: 'unclassified', rateLimited: false, error: ... }`.
     - Wire `classifyAgyOutcome(...)` inside `runAgy()` and include `rateLimited: Boolean(classified.rateLimited)` on the resolved `runAgy()` result.

4. Atomic `lib/scheduler.mjs` Handling:
   - Handle every `kind` in `ALL_AGY_ERROR_KINDS`:
     - `'signal'`, `'timeout'`, `'interrupted'`, `'spawn'`: `strikes += 1`, `safeResetToBase()`, skip `recordStrikeSession()`, do NOT increment `fleetCliFailures`.
     - `'model_unavailable'`: add `model` to run-scoped `disabledModels` `Set`, clear `lastConversationId = null` and `lastStrikeModel = null`, reroute via `tierCandidates` with `0` strikes consumed (if zero candidates remain, `strikes += 1` and fail cleanly).
     - `build.rateLimited === true`: call `pools.refreshQuota(...)`; when `strikes < 2` (at most 1 free rate-limit reroute per strike) and an alternate candidate in another non-depleted pool exists, clear `lastConversationId = null` and `lastStrikeModel = null` (so `warmResume` never passes the prior model's `conversationId` to the new pool!) and reroute cross-pool without incrementing `strikes`.

5. Tests & Build (`test/agy-1-5-9-print.test.mjs`):
   - Test all 14 canonical hand-authored golden vectors (1 per Row `1..14`, plus `'completed'` benign `finished_reason` with `code: 0, status: 'SUCCESS'` -> `ok: true`, `'max_tokens'` -> `ok: false, kind: 'server'`, `'cannot open model.json: file not found'` -> NOT `'model_unavailable'`, trailing Go shutdown line after `AGY_ERROR: {"code":429,"status":"RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"}` -> `rateLimited: true`, and `< 1.5.0` vs `>= 1.5.0` `text` timeout).
   - Test the exact `1,440`-state cross-product (`3 outputFormats * 2 killReasons * 4 [code,signal] pairs [[0,null],[1,null],[3,null],[null,'SIGKILL']] * 5 result states * 4 finishedReasons [undefined,'completed','print_timeout','max_tokens'] * 3 lastErrLines = 1,440` states), asserting every result has `ok === (kind === null)`, every non-null `kind` is in `ALL_AGY_ERROR_KINDS`, and Rows `1..13` are each hit `>= 1` time.
   - Add scheduler integration tests using `fake-agy` verifying `'signal'` does not bump `fleetCliFailures`, `'model_unavailable'` demotes without burning a strike, and `rateLimited` cross-pool reroute clears `lastConversationId`/`lastStrikeModel`.
   - Run `npm run build && node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs && npm test` (and verify `node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check` exits 0).

edges.contract: T4 exports RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION = '1.5.9', MIN_AGY_VERSION = '1.2.6', checkAgyBinary() (including version field), and checkHookLogDir() from lib/doctor.mjs; exports FAILURE_FINISHED_REASONS, ALL_AGY_ERROR_KINDS, and classifyAgyOutcome() (returning { ok, kind, rateLimited, error }) from lib/agy.mjs; supports optional boolean plan.disableOrchestrator in lib/brain.mjs + lib/plan.mjs; and wires signal/timeout/interrupted/model_unavailable/rateLimited handling in lib/scheduler.mjs. T5 consumes checkAgyBinary().version, plan.disableOrchestrator, and build.kind/build.rateLimited in lib/scheduler.mjs + lib/models.mjs + lib/status.mjs without editing lib/agy.mjs or lib/doctor.mjs.

title: Add --disable-slash-commands, RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION 1.5.9, and 1,440-state classifyAgyOutcome()
